set.body:
Outcome

Implement the first complete predictive scientific program.

Acceptance

- Run groups compile to an exact validation design.
- Standardization fits only on analysis rows.
- Learner fitting, assessment, optional selection, and refit roles are explicit.
- Configuration, fitted-stage signatures, seeds, and observed sample sets are receipted.
- No old Classifier, Response, or FoldPlan type enters the new compiler.
set.title: P4A.4: compile leave-one-run-out standardize-and-classify through Alder
